about: Sundaram Finance Holdings Ltd is primarily engaged in the business of Investments, business processing, and support services. It has a 100% subsidiary which is an outsourcing company offering various support services to large and mid-sized firms in and outside India. [1]

The Company generates a significant portion of its income from dividend flows from the portfolio companies that are engaged in the automotive sector. [1]
